name: Massachusetts
notes: bbox is [min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat], matching pmtiles extract --bbox. Massachusetts' extent (Census TIGER, rounded outward), including Cape Cod, Martha's Vineyard and Nantucket: Nantucket and Nomans Land set the south edge at 41.23 and Monomoy/Chatham the east edge at -69.92. Open Atlantic east of the Cape is trimmed; Cape Cod Bay, Nantucket Sound and Massachusetts Bay inside the box cannot be trimmed with a rectangle. maxzoom 14 is where OSM street geometry stops adding detail; z15+ roughly doubles the file for labels the phone can render from z14 data.

geofabrik.notes: Not used for the roads basemap (Protomaps already renders the planet). It is the input the routing graph needs, and the state.txt timestamp is what check_upstream.py watches for maps-routing-us-ma.
